technical.summary: MCD shows solid structural bullish alignment with price above all key moving averages and positive momentum indicators, but lacks trend strength (weak ADX) and MACD confirmation, making this a moderate-quality swing entry suitable for risk-managed positions.

fundamental.summary: MCD shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 93 days—fundamental backdrop is neutral to weak.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; mixed sentiment with fear reading (40) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and junior-level trading activity limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (346.7), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinational revenues, FOMC event in 1 day, and earnings in 93 days create compounded uncertainty for MCD.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with supertrend bullish and rising OBV volume suggests structural upside momentum despite weak trend confirmation.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, FOMC in 1 day, rising USD), weak ADX trend strength, no MACD confirmation, high earnings risk in 93 days, and zero fundamental conviction create compounded downside risk that outweighs technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows price above moving averages with bullish supertrend, but macro environment is severely hostile with VIX in crisis mode, FOMC event imminent, and flat yield curve signalling recession risk that overwhelms technical strength.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC decision in 1 day combined with VIX crisis levels (346.7) and earnings risk in 93 days create compounded volatility that could trigger sharp reversals regardless of technical setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
